record.title: Entity governing documents and formation-law route
kv: Applicable entity-formation law plus charter, bylaws/operating agreement, board or member action, and contract; Delaware corporate law is the bounded statutory example.
The question is who may direct a legal entity, appoint officers, authorize contracts, or allocate internal fiduciary and voting powers.

Boards of directors of corporations; Managers of manager-managed LLCs; Members of member-managed LLCs; Other entity governing bodies only as provided by applicable formation law and governing documents

Identify the exact legal entity and formation jurisdiction. Recover current governing documents and the relevant authorization record. Separate entity governance from regulatory permission, network governance, and asset-holder rights.
A corporate board, foundation, DAO vote, or product committee does not obtain public-law authority or control a separately issued asset absent the governing instrument and applicable law.

sources.label: Delaware General Corporation Law section 141: board management

scope_note: A browsing entity/group does not inherit another legal entity’s permissions.
